Do not copy its landscape, framing, pond, camera or flow width.

Unknown physical flow direction is not evidence; do not add arrows. This is a synthetic appearance hypothesis, not validated physical dynamics.

Add only the guided central braided low-channel ribbon, leaving the broad original dry banks, right-hand terrace, road, left cliff and selected central gravel islands exposed.
